SELECT CG.CODE_GROUP, CG.GROUP_NAME, CG.DESCRIPTION AS GROUP_DESCRIPTION,
C.CODE, C.CODE_NAME, C.DESCRIPTION AS CODE_DESCRIPTION,
C.SORT_ORDER
FROM MST_CODE_GROUP CG INNER JOIN MST_CODE C ON C.CODE_GROUP = CG.CODE_GROUP
WHERE 1=1 AND CG.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY CG.CODE_GROUP, C.SORT_ORDER, C.CODE
